article.title: From Allende to Chávez: 2 popular models, same imperialist and oligarchic conspiracy
article.author: Editor
article.content: As Chile commemorates the 1973 coup, the kidnapping of Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro confirms that the U.S. conspiracy against popular projects in Latin America has not stopped, it has merely changed its name. The post From Allende to Chávez: 2 popular models, same imperialist and oligarchic conspiracy appeared first on MR Online .
